profile.title: Junior Web Developer
profile.heroDesc: I build clean, responsive, and user-friendly web applications, from pixel-perfect front ends to solid back-end APIs. Based in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

about.sub: A passionate developer from Rajshahi, Bangladesh on a mission to build great web experiences.
paragraphs: I'm a motivated Junior Web Developer with hands-on experience building responsive, performant web applications using modern front-end and back-end stacks.

Comfortable taking a feature from wireframe to deployed product: writing clean, semantic HTML/CSS, interactive JavaScript, and connecting to REST APIs. I'm a proud member of Programming Hero Club where I continuously sharpen my development skills.

Eager to join a collaborative IT team where I can ship real value, learn production best practices, and grow into a full-stack role. Currently pursuing my B.Sc. in CSE and open to full-time, remote, or freelance opportunities.

projects.title: Cancer Detector
projects.stack: Python, Machine Learning, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy
projects.desc: A machine learning system that classifies cancer from medical dataset features using ensemble algorithms, achieving 94% test accuracy.
bullets: Logistic Regression, Random Forest & SVM classifiers trained on real medical data
Data preprocessing & feature selection with Pandas & NumPy, reaching 94% accuracy
ROC curve, confusion matrix & feature importance charts via Matplotlib & Seaborn
Real-time prediction pipeline packaged for new patient inputs

projects.title: Foodi Desh
projects.desc: A full-stack food delivery web platform with restaurant browsing, cart, order placement, live tracking, and an admin dashboard.
bullets: Laravel MVC back-end with RESTful routes and Eloquent ORM
Role-based access: Admin, Restaurant Owner & Customer portals
Fully responsive HTML/CSS/JS front-end across all screen sizes
Live order status tracking and restaurant management dashboard

projects.title: Eco-Hand: Second-Hand Device Buy/Sell Platform
projects.stack: Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB Atlas, Tailwind CSS
projects.desc: A full-stack marketplace for buying and selling second-hand electronic devices, reducing e-waste with a modern, responsive interface.
bullets: Developed a full-stack marketplace with product listings, cart, and transaction management
Built scalable REST APIs with Express.js and MongoDB Atlas for product, user & transaction data
Implemented secure authentication and protected routes using BetterAuth / JWT
Integrated Cloudinary for device image uploads; deployed on Vercel for production hosting

projects.title: Customer Churn Analysis & Retention Dashboard
projects.desc: A data analyst project on the IBM Telco Customer Churn dataset (7,043 customers), identifying churn drivers and building an interactive retention dashboard.
bullets: Cleaned & aggregated data with Pandas; wrote 10 SQL queries for churn KPIs
Found 42.71% churn on month-to-month contracts vs. 2.83% on 2-year contracts
Built a formula-driven Excel summary (COUNTIFS/SUMIF) and interactive HTML dashboard
Delivered 5 actionable retention recommendations tied to $139K/month revenue at risk

projects.title: E-Commerce Sales & Customer Analysis Dashboard
projects.stack: Python (Pandas), SQL, RFM Segmentation, Excel, Chart.js
projects.desc: Analyzed 541,909 transactions from the UCI Online Retail dataset to identify profitable products, markets, and customer segments.
bullets: Cleaned transactional data & built an RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) segmentation model
Segmented 4,338 customers into Champions, Loyal, At Risk & Lost groups
Uncovered £10.6M total revenue across 38 countries and a clear November seasonal peak
Built formula-driven Excel workbook and an interactive sales dashboard
